# sovrium

> Own the system that runs your organization: one config file, run by one binary on your own infrastructure.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/sovrium/sovrium): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://sovrium.com): Official website and documentation.
